notes: User selected image candidate 2, 砂耳の旅人: sandy fennec fur, upright triangular ears, green irises, projecting muzzle, hide/fur clothes, bare paws and tail retained.
Local TRELLIS-2 1024; measured source-preserving reduction to 103314 triangles. No visible primitive substitution.

Exact GLB SHA checked in actual IAB; magic impact pose and five-model run displayed, with no console warnings/errors. Observed 60 FPS for one, 43 FPS for five while Blender rendered; not a constant-FPS claim.
Game QA pending separately; species bear, magic and movement speeds retained. Collision radius .32 m provides extra tail clearance.
